title: The Last Delivery
style: 2D anime, soft cel shading, muted palette with warm neon accents, cinematic lighting

characters.name: Mika
characters.look: a 20-year-old courier girl, short messy black bob, bright yellow rain jacket over a grey hoodie, black cargo pants, a battered delivery bag across her chest

characters.name: Mrs. Hana
characters.look: an 80-year-old woman, silver hair in a low bun, round glasses, a cream knitted cardigan over a dark green dress

locations.name: Rainy street
locations.look: a narrow city street at night in heavy rain, glowing shop signs, wet asphalt reflecting neon

locations.name: Apartment doorway
locations.look: the open wooden door of an old apartment, warm lamplight spilling into a dim corridor, a small shoe rack and a potted plant

shots.prompt: Wide tracking shot. Mika rides a small electric scooter through the rain, brakes hard and checks the address on a soaked parcel.
Medium two-shot, slow push-in. Mrs. Hana opens the door; Mika, dripping wet, holds the parcel out with both hands.

dialogue.line: Nobody has sent me anything in years.

shots.prompt: Close-up, static camera, shallow depth of field. Mrs. Hana unwraps an old envelope, reads the handwriting, and smiles as her eyes fill with tears.
